teacher_info.intro:
Having grown up in Germany and spent my childhood years living in Australia, I developed a profound appreciation for living internationally. When I turned 10, my family and I moved back to the States, and I faced firsthand the challenges of adapting and learning to adjust to a new culture. I have deep empathy and understanding for ESL students who are often faced with the same challenges; a significant motivating factor in helping students feel prepared for success in a new cultural and academic environment.

I live in Seattle, WA, surrounded by the stunning landscapes of the Pacific Northwest. I enjoy exploring the beautiful Cascade Mountains and the Olympic Peninsula in my free time.

My experience includes working with business professionals, children ages 5-14, and learners who are speaking English with a native speaker for the first time.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe my success as a teacher stems from my deep awareness of students' needs. I shape my lessons by observing and responding to what I perceive a student needs at any given moment. With experience teaching hundreds of lesson plans for students of all levels, I can quickly draw on my knowledge to provide effective, targeted content and activities tailored to each student's needs. I take pride in identifying areas for growth quickly, often applying this approach to support multiple students in larger classes.

It has been a true pleasure to watch students grow in confidence, progressing from A1 learners to near-native speakers at C2 levels, able to speak spontaneously and at great length.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description: In this class, we will cover a variety of topics to help you improve your fluency, expand your vocabulary, and learn useful phrases, sayings, and idioms. We will have engaging discussions on topics like scientific articles or current events, and you can also choose subjects that interest you. During the lesson, I'll give you feedback on the areas you'd like to improve. I will also take notes on areas that can be strengthened, and we’ll review these notes together at the end of each session.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction - Speak More Like a Native North American Speaker!
pro_course_detail.description: In this course, I’ll start by assessing your goals, challenges, and how you use English. We’ll then focus on areas where you need improvement, using simple exercises. We’ll practice American English sounds with sentence drills, and speaking activities to help you develop a clear accent. I’ll show you exactly how to make those tricky sounds. Plus, you’ll get extra practice activities and resources to help you continue learning on your own.

pro_course_detail.title: Practical Business English Skills
pro_course_detail.description: In this course, you’ll build confidence in speaking English. With over 6,000 students taught from countries like Brazil, Japan, China, France, and Germany, and experience working with companies like L'Oréal and InBev, I’m here to help you improve. Tell me how you prefer to be corrected, and I’ll provide feedback on your speaking, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation. We’ll focus on key areas like Business English, Networking, Meetings, Presentations, and Job Interviews. Ready to take your English to the next level? Let’s get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Fluency Practice: Preparing to Travel to an English-Speaking Country
pro_course_detail.description: In this course, we’ll focus on helping you feel confident traveling to the United States or any English-speaking country. We’ll practice real-life situations through roleplays, build key vocabulary, and prepare you for anything you might encounter during your trip. I can even customize lessons based on your travel plans to make sure you’re fully ready to use your English skills with confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Test Preperation
pro_course_detail.description: In this course, we'll explore the IELTS exam in detail. You'll gain a clear understanding of the scoring criteria and discover effective strategies to achieve the band score you need. With a wide range of mock IELTS questions, I’ll provide personalized feedback and advice to help you improve. I am fully certified to teach IELTS prep. Need help crafting your Task 1 and Task 2 responses? I’ll guide you through the process! Start your IELTS journey with me today!

teacher_info.introduction: I have been teaching English for more than 10yrs now. I have taught in schools, online and one on one tutoring. I have taken online courses on how to teach and have found certain methods that I feel work well.I have taught students anywhere from 3 years old to 60+years old. I started out teaching children and have now increased my experience to adults. I also have experience teaching business English to adults and helping recently graduated students through the interview process in English. My business background is in accounting/payroll and IT support. I am fluent in Spanish and having learned it myself have a very good understanding of the grammar and pronunciation. I believe that the most important in learning a new language is for you to speak as much as possible and lose your fear of making mistakes. I know how difficult it can be to learn a new language so I hope that through my experience I can help you. In our classes together we will learn grammar but focus mainly on speaking and accent. When we speak we speak in the past tense a lot so that is a place I like to begin usually. I recommend taking at least one class a week but more if possible. Learning a language should be fun and exciting so be prepared to laugh and enjoy my class! I look forward to meeting you!

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have been teaching English for over 10 years now.  I have taught students from age 3- 65 years old.  I believe that anyone no matter how young or old can learn a language if they find the correct method and teacher for them.  I like to provide a relaxed teaching environment.  If we are relaxed and having fun learning, retaining information will come.  I love to laugh so be prepared to have a good time in my class!
teacher_info.teaching_style: For new English learners I feel that starting with the past tense is helpful.  We are constantly talking about what happened in the past.  Using pictures and physical response also helps to solidify concepts in our mind.  It is important to engage all the senses when learning and I believe this includes sense of humor!  For intermediate to advanced speakers I like to select relevant topics from the news media and/or of interest to the student. I also help to prepare students for job interviews, teach about American culture, etiquette and American humor.   No matter what level you are the most important is that you speak, speak, speak!

teacher_info.teaching_style:
All classes are customized to student needs. However, the basic structure is as follows:

For writing classes, we will spend the time editing a writing sample you provide (prompts and questions can be given). We will review grammar, spelling, cohesion, vocabulary and structure.

For pronunciation, we cover four key concepts needed for a natural accent in American English: placement, pitch, breath, and weak consonants. We take a pronunciation test to find the specific areas of strength and focus before moving to sentence-level structures (intonation, linking, stress, reductions). Our long-term goal: to listen to native speakers, identify what techniques they use, and copy them ourselves.

 **Please note: this lesson will not provide services like potential IELTS scores, in-depth writing analysis, or detailed feedback on grammar/vocab/pronunciation. Students may only select this option once**

Specifically, we will:

- Go over what your personal goals are for your English

- Discuss why you are studying English

- Create a study plan that you can use in the future

- Review study strategies and techniques for improving writing, vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, or speaking--depending on your area of focus

- Answer any questions you have

30 minutes is generally plenty to cover these topics! The hour option is only to handle any questions we cannot cover and may end early if all questions are answered.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Are you ready to go beyond simple conversation and be challenged to use English in different ways? Are you eager to level up your vocabulary (and learn plenty of useful phrases like "level up"?) Do you want thoughtful corrections so you can sound more natural when you speak?

In my lessons, you can expect specific and useful feedback - but never too much at one time. The most important thing to me as a teacher? I want you to feel encouraged, not overwhelmed.

I create plenty of time and space in my lessons so that we can go at your pace. I always consider your interests and learning style.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Lessons with me will force you to stretch and use every bit of English you know! You'll get to answer questions such as "Tell me more about x" or "What are some other meanings of _____ that you know?" or "What's another way we can say ___?" 

For every lesson, I'll give you quality materials (usually a PDF or a slideshow) on interesting topics that include videos, readings, exercises, and more. Through speaking-focused activities, we'll help you expand on what you know and become more calm and confident about your speaking skills.

If you'd like homework, I will provide it! My students each have a Google Doc document where I write this, a list of what we learned, and additional feedback.

course_info.trial_description: Welcome! Thank you so much for scheduling a trial lesson, I cannot wait to meet you. This first connection will set the theme for the following courses to really get to know each other and design the absolute most successful English plan for you. What is your main focus? What inspires you? What is your preferred learning style and how do you learn best? What are your strengths and weaknesses? Do you like cats or dogs more?? =^.^= this is also to get to know each other, our personalities and lives. In this no-pressure free flow lesson, I will be able to assess your language level and provide insight into the next plan of action, as well as go over class expectations for both of us. Remember: YOU are the captain. This is for you, and I am here in any way to help and adjust to your goals. Let's get started!!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Intermediate Level and Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description: This is where the fun starts! In this course, we will discuss a diverse variety of subjects to best increase your speaking, fluency, and vocabulary with CONFIDENCE in any topic! Music? Cultural traditions? Personal life and hobbies? Entertainment? Travel? Religion and Politics? Philosophy? Comedy? Well, you get the point :) The sky is the limit! My conversation courses are engaging, open, free-flowing, and always fun and full of energy. I am flexible with the focus and always prepared with questions, themes, current event topics, deep thinker conversations, and games. Also, let me know what YOU think and would like to know more about! The more you speak, the more you will improve. Practice makes perfect. Don't be afraid to make mistakes- that means you are human and that is how you learn. Now: less reading, let's get chatting!

pro_course_detail.title: Confidence in Public Speaking, Interviews, and Presentations
pro_course_detail.description: Let's be honest: speaking in front of people in your native language can be nerve-wracking in itself, let alone doing it in a foreign language! But do not lose hope: there are countless ways to prepare yourself and gain confidence so you can ace your next interview, presentation, or debate. In this course, we will focus on two essential concepts: 1) organization and 2) delivery. Organizing will help you develop your plan of action, what to say, how to respond, and what materials you will need. The second focus of delivery covers simply the best way to effectively leave a positive impression on an audience or interviewer and to develop people skills and confidence. The combination of these will carry you to success. Included are mock interviews, practicing presentations, and debates.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Beginners!
pro_course_detail.description: Let's get into the basic fundamental and necessary aspects of English! In this type of lesson, we will review everyday common vocabulary and SOS essential phrases. We will also cover basic grammar structures and have casual and common conversations. My pace will be clear and slow. I am here to support you, don't be scared. We all get nervous speaking in other languages and make mistakes. That is normal! Here I will help you gain confidence to move into the intermediate level. Late's get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Speaking
pro_course_detail.description: Congratulations! You have made it to the advanced English speaking level. Give yourself a pat on the back because you have worked hard to get here. In this course, the sky is the limit. We will use advanced vocabulary and develop your fluency. Time to perfect pronunciation and dive into deep and interesting topics. Let's get started!

teacher_info.intro: I am a Native English speaker living in the good 'ole USA.  I am Certified, and I have taught students from China, to Poland, to Brazil....  I am also a language learner, so I understand the difficulties that come along with learning a foreign language.  I am a published science fiction author, and I love to speculate about the unknown.  Writing is my passion, and so are words!
teacher_info.short_signature: Helping students to bridge the gap between written and spoken English for more than 8 years!
teacher_info.introduction: I have over thirteen years of study with the English language. I am currently in the process of learning a new language, and I would like to employ many of the methods that have worked for me. For instance, the value of starting from the ground. The alphabet and accurate pronunciation is the foundation to learning a new language. Sentence composition, use of components of speech (conjunctions, object pronouns, phrasal verbs) should be learned and practiced in real time.  I hope that my course is simple yet challenging enough to stimulate the mind of the student so that they can understand and retain what they are learning.

I will provide you with a contextual learning environment where you can connect what you're learning with the things that you already know!

This approach is both challenging and fun. More importantly, it will help you to use the English language in a more meaningful way.
